svg.text: Fusion AM · negative space · box styles
The refined base: one silhouette, one slit.
Your diary sketch: three bars launch into
the AM; the slit cuts bars and letters
Bars and letters split wide; a red
overtaking line runs through the gap.
Solid italic tile, AM knocked out; the slit
splits the tile and the top half surges
Open frame: two chamfered corner brackets,
///AM knocked out of a number-plate tile
A thinner visor crest: a team badge for
Rounded italic tile, softer and more
